title: Two Out of Three
goal: Return values present in at least two of three arrays.
strategy: Deduplicate each array before recording membership. A value needs two distinct source arrays, not merely two occurrences inside one array.

phasePurposes.start: Return values present in at least two of three arrays.

phasePurposes.done: Return values present in at least two of three arrays.

edgeCases: Many copies in one array are still one membership
Every value appears in all sources
Only two sources share a value
